name: Alacritty
why: My favorite terminal is alacritty because it’s simple reliable and in every OS.

quotes.quote: My favorite terminal is alacritty because it’s simple reliable and in every OS.
quotes.excerpt: I just run Claude Code in tmux+alacritty. My favorite terminal is alacritty because it’s simple reliable and in every OS. I use the same setup across Windows, Linux, and Mac machines. Great setup for constantly using different OSs.
quotes.story: Ask HN: What's your desktop setup optimized to work with AI?
